raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`ForwardBatch.init_new` already constructs token positions on the forward device. For an ordinary text-only EXTEND, `_compute_mrope_positions_extend` then rebuilds the same positions with per-request CPU `arange`/`repeat`, concatenates them, and uploads the three-axis tensor to the device.

Reuse the existing device positions when all three MRoPE axes are identical. This avoids the redundant host construction and pageable host-to-device copy while keeping the existing fallback paths. For 4096 eligible EXTEND tokens, the removed upload is 96 KiB per rank per call (192 KiB across TP2 when both ranks execute that call), in addition to avoiding the CPU position-building work. These are resource savings; an end-to-end latency benefit still needs an isolated A/B measurement.

**Validation status:** submitted for review so the upstream Draft gate does not prevent CI. This is not a claim that validation is complete. A dedicated GPU host is not currently available for an isolated upstream A/B run; CUDA correctness and performance results remain pending. This PR does not claim an end-to-end speedup and is not ready to merge without the remaining validation.

## Modifications

- Add a text-only EXTEND fast path that converts the existing positions to int64 and repeats them across the three MRoPE axes on their current device.
- Retain the original path for multimodal batches, DLLM, on-policy deterministic mode, and speculative metadata carrying explicit positions.
- Allow speculative metadata objects whose `positions` is absent/None to use the text path, instead of excluding every `spec_info` object.
- Add CPU regression coverage for prefix/chunk offsets, int32/int64 input positions, empty/4096-token chunks, metadata without explicit positions, and fallback coordinate preservation.
- No model-specific dispatch, new flag, quantization change, attention kernel change, or cache-policy change.

Related but separate: #46332 addresses multimodal decode delta uploads; #46781 addresses speculative multimodal delta uploads. This PR only changes the text-only EXTEND construction path.

## Accuracy Tests

- **Full-runtime CPU validation passed:** https://github.com/RedMoonnn/sglang/actions/runs/41819935923 . The hosted Ubuntu runner installed the upstream `python[dev]` environment and directly executed the actual submitted test file, without AST isolation: 6 MRoPE tests passed (including 128 randomized batch/dtype/offset cases), followed by all 9 neighboring ForwardBatch plan-record tests. Environment: Python 3.12.16, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, no GPU available. No model weights or serving process were needed.
- That hosted job tested commit `3334ceda1f344ddc8a5fb3849252db819bbdb42d`. The current head `ad1f6ea9676a11f5c5aea19047ef995096d5b16e` only adds the CUDA test file; the production and CPU-test blobs are unchanged.
- The no-CPU-rebuild regression also fails against the unpatched method for both plain text and metadata-without-positions in the local source-isolated red/green check.
- **Upstream full pre-commit lint passed for the current head:** https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41820571073 . PR-title and CI-registration checks also passed.
- Added `test/registered/model_executor/test_mrope_positions_cuda.py`, registered for one small CUDA CI runner. It covers exact int32/int64 results, no CPU `arange` rebuild or host synchronization in the text path, non-default stream ordering, and mixed multimodal fallback coordinates. **CUDA execution remains pending**; a maintainer has been asked to authorize the scoped rerun.
- Model-level output equivalence and isolated end-to-end performance have **not** been validated on a clean upstream GPU build for this PR.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

### Source-level savings

Let `N` be the total number of EXTEND tokens in this call, not the full cached context length. The old path uploads a `[3, N]` int64 position tensor after constructing it on the CPU; the new path constructs that tensor from positions already on the forward device.

| Resource | Before | With this fast path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Position-specific host-to-device payload, per rank/call | `3 * N * 8` bytes | No host-to-device upload for this tensor |
| At `N = 4096` | 96 KiB/rank; 192 KiB across TP2 if both ranks execute the call | Removed |
| At `N = 16384` | 384 KiB/rank; 768 KiB across TP2 under the same condition | Removed |
| CPU construction | Per-request CPU `arange`/three-axis `repeat`, a Python assembly loop, and CPU `cat` | These operations are bypassed; the text-only eligibility check remains |
| Concatenated CPU tensor payload | `3 * N * 8` bytes, in addition to per-request construction temporaries | That host staging tensor is not built |
| Final device MRoPE tensor | `[3, N]` int64 | Still `[3, N]` int64; no KV-cache/weight-memory reduction |

The byte counts above follow from tensor shape and dtype; they are not measured speedups or measured process-RSS reductions. Device-side `repeat` still materializes the result. An int32 input also requires an int64 conversion (an additional `N * 8`-byte temporary), whereas an already-int64 input does not need a dtype-conversion allocation.

Removing this pageable upload also removes a host-side submission point that can wait behind preceding GPU work. How much of that wait lies on the request's critical path must be measured; it must not be counted wholesale as saved wall-clock time.

### Preliminary downstream trace observation

A prior bounded Nsight diagnostic on a customized two-rank GB10 deployment using the same reuse strategy reported:

| Rank | Captured metadata intervals | Cumulative full metadata-interval time | 98,304-byte copy events in the captured window |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 11 | 18.272 ms | 0 |
| 1 | 12 | 17.895 ms | 0 |

This is a downstream sanity observation, **not** an isolated benchmark of this PR on clean upstream. The metadata times include other metadata work, are cumulative rather than per request, and have no matched before/after timing comparison here. They do not establish an end-to-end speedup or standalone MRoPE latency reduction. Other host-to-device transfers are not claimed to be eliminated.

### Validation still pending

A dedicated GPU host is not currently available for a clean-upstream A/B run. No TTFT, TPOT, throughput, or wall-clock improvement is claimed.

Before marking ready for review, validate the removed upload with a bounded trace and measure metadata/TTFT under the same inputs, cache state, batch sizes, and serving parameters. Run detailed profiling separately from the final timing comparison.

## Checklist

- [x] Ruff 0.15.1 lint/format checks and isort 7.0.0 checks passed for both changed files; `git diff --check` passed.
- [x] Full upstream pre-commit CI passed (run 41820571073); the full local pre-commit environment was not recreated.
- [x] Add focused CPU and CUDA regression coverage using the repository CI registrations and `CustomTestCase`.
- [x] Run the CPU regressions in a complete upstream development environment on a hosted fork runner (15 test methods passed); protected upstream CPU/CUDA CI still requires maintainer authorization.
- [ ] Complete clean-upstream GPU correctness and isolated performance validation.
- [x] No user-facing documentation change: no new option or API.

@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+"""CUDA coverage for device-side text MRoPE construction; no model weights."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+import sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info as fbi
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+def _make_batch(prefixes, lengths, dtype=torch.int64, spec_info=None):
+    fb = ForwardBatch.__new__(ForwardBatch)
+    fb.seq_lens_cpu = torch.tensor(
+        [prefix + length for prefix, length in zip(prefixes, lengths)],
+        dtype=torch.int64,
+    )
+    fb.positions = torch.cat(
+        [
+            torch.arange(prefix, prefix + length, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+            for prefix, length in zip(prefixes, lengths)
+        ]
+    )
+    fb.spec_info = spec_info
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        multimodal_inputs=[None] * len(prefixes),
+        extend_lens=lengths,
+        prefix_lens=prefixes,
+        dllm_config=None,
+        reqs=[SimpleNamespace(session=None) for _ in prefixes],
+    )
+    return fb, batch
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "Requires CUDA")
+class TestMRopePositionsCUDA(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.runner = SimpleNamespace(device="cuda")
+        context = SimpleNamespace(
+            deterministic=SimpleNamespace(rl_on_policy_target=None)
+        )
+        patcher = patch.object(fbi, "get_exec", return_value=context)
+        patcher.start()
+        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
+
+    def test_text_positions_without_cpu_rebuild_or_host_sync(self):
+        for dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+            for bs in (1, 4):
+                for spec_info in (None, SimpleNamespace(positions=None)):
+                    with self.subTest(dtype=dtype, bs=bs, spec_info=spec_info):
+                        fb, batch = _make_batch(
+                            [17 * i for i in range(bs)],
+                            [4096] * bs,
+                            dtype,
+                            spec_info,
+                        )
+                        expected = fb.positions.to(torch.int64).expand(3, -1).clone()
+                        before = fb.positions.clone()
+                        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                        previous = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+                        try:
+                            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+                            with patch.object(
+                                torch,
+                                "arange",
+                                side_effect=AssertionError("CPU rebuild"),
+                            ):
+                                fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+                        finally:
+                            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(previous)
+                        self.assertEqual(fb.mrope_positions.device, fb.positions.device)
+                        self.assertEqual(fb.mrope_positions.dtype, torch.int64)
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(
+                            fb.mrope_positions, expected, rtol=0, atol=0
+                        )
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(fb.positions, before, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_non_default_stream_observes_prior_position_updates(self):
+        fb, batch = _make_batch([0], [2048], torch.int32)
+        expected = (fb.positions.to(torch.int64) + 8).expand(3, -1).clone()
+        batch.prefix_lens = [8]
+        fb.seq_lens_cpu += 8
+        stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            fb.positions.add_(8)
+            fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+        stream.synchronize()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(fb.mrope_positions, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    def test_mixed_multimodal_fallback_preserves_spatial_axes(self):
+        fb, batch = _make_batch([1, 8], [2, 2])
+        batch.multimodal_inputs[0] = SimpleNamespace(
+            mrope_positions=torch.tensor(
+                [[0, 1, 2, 3], [100, 101, 102, 103], [200, 201, 202, 203]],
+                dtype=torch.int64,
+            )
+        )
+        expected = torch.tensor(
+            [[1, 2, 8, 9], [101, 102, 8, 9], [201, 202, 8, 9]],
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(fb.mrope_positions, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+"""CPU-only regression coverage for text-only MRoPE EXTEND positions."""
+
+import random
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+import sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info as fbi
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _make_batch(prefixes, lengths, dtype=torch.int64, spec_info=None):
+    fb = ForwardBatch.__new__(ForwardBatch)
+    fb.seq_lens_cpu = torch.tensor(
+        [prefix + length for prefix, length in zip(prefixes, lengths)],
+        dtype=torch.int64,
+    )
+    fb.positions = torch.cat(
+        [
+            torch.arange(prefix, prefix + length, dtype=dtype)
+            for prefix, length in zip(prefixes, lengths)
+        ]
+    )
+    fb.spec_info = spec_info
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        multimodal_inputs=[None] * len(prefixes),
+        extend_lens=lengths,
+        prefix_lens=prefixes,
+        dllm_config=None,
+        reqs=[SimpleNamespace(session=None) for _ in prefixes],
+    )
+    return fb, batch
+
+
+class TestMRopeExtendPositions(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.runner = SimpleNamespace(device="cpu")
+        self.exec_ctx = SimpleNamespace(
+            deterministic=SimpleNamespace(rl_on_policy_target=None)
+        )
+        self.exec_patch = patch.object(fbi, "get_exec", return_value=self.exec_ctx)
+        self.exec_patch.start()
+        self.addCleanup(self.exec_patch.stop)
+
+    def test_text_positions_match_prefix_and_chunk_lengths(self):
+        rng = random.Random(901103)
+        for bs in (1, 2, 4, 8):
+            for dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+                for trial in range(16):
+                    prefixes = [rng.randrange(200001) for _ in range(bs)]
+                    lengths = [rng.randrange(33) for _ in range(bs)]
+                    with self.subTest(bs=bs, dtype=dtype, trial=trial):
+                        fb, batch = _make_batch(prefixes, lengths, dtype)
+                        before = fb.positions.clone()
+                        expected = torch.tensor(
+                            [
+                                pos
+                                for prefix, length in zip(prefixes, lengths)
+                                for pos in range(prefix, prefix + length)
+                            ],
+                            dtype=torch.int64,
+                        ).expand(3, -1)
+                        fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+                        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.mrope_positions, expected))
+                        self.assertEqual(fb.mrope_positions.dtype, torch.int64)
+                        self.assertEqual(fb.mrope_positions.device.type, "cpu")
+                        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.positions, before))
+
+    def test_empty_and_long_chunks(self):
+        for lengths in ([0, 0], [0, 4096], [4096, 4096]):
+            with self.subTest(lengths=lengths):
+                fb, batch = _make_batch([0, 200000], lengths)
+                expected = fb.positions.expand(3, -1).clone()
+                fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+                self.assertEqual(tuple(fb.mrope_positions.shape), (3, sum(lengths)))
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.mrope_positions, expected))
+
+    def test_text_and_nextn_metadata_do_not_rebuild_cpu_positions(self):
+        for spec_info in (None, SimpleNamespace(positions=None)):
+            with self.subTest(spec_info=spec_info):
+                fb, batch = _make_batch([8], [4], spec_info=spec_info)
+                expected = torch.tensor([[8, 9, 10, 11]] * 3, dtype=torch.int64)
+                with patch.object(
+                    torch, "arange", side_effect=AssertionError("CPU rebuild")
+                ):
+                    fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.mrope_positions, expected))
+
+    def test_dllm_and_deterministic_modes_keep_original_coordinates(self):
+        expected = torch.tensor([[8, 9]] * 3, dtype=torch.int64)
+        for mode in ("dllm", "deterministic"):
+            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
+                fb, batch = _make_batch([8], [2])
+                fb.positions = torch.tensor([100, 101], dtype=torch.int64)
+                batch.dllm_config = object() if mode == "dllm" else None
+                self.exec_ctx.deterministic.rl_on_policy_target = (
+                    object() if mode == "deterministic" else None
+                )
+                fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.mrope_positions, expected))
+
+    def test_explicit_speculative_positions_keep_original_fallback(self):
+        fb, batch = _make_batch(
+            [8], [2], spec_info=SimpleNamespace(positions=torch.tensor([100, 101]))
+        )
+        fb.positions = torch.tensor([100, 101], dtype=torch.int64)
+        fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.mrope_positions, torch.tensor([[8, 9]] * 3)))
+
+    def test_mixed_multimodal_batch_preserves_axis_positions(self):
+        fb, batch = _make_batch([1, 8], [2, 2])
+        mm_positions = torch.tensor(
+            [[0, 1, 2, 3], [100, 101, 102, 103], [200, 201, 202, 203]],
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+        )
+        batch.multimodal_inputs[0] = SimpleNamespace(mrope_positions=mm_positions)
+        expected = torch.tensor(
+            [[1, 2, 8, 9], [101, 102, 8, 9], [201, 202, 8, 9]],
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+        )
+        fb._compute_mrope_positions_extend(self.runner, batch)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(fb.mrope_positions, expected))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
